command:
set -eu
if ! id appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appworker; fi
umask 022
printf '%s\n' 'appworker soft nofile 8192' 'appworker hard nofile 8192' 'appworker soft nproc 256' 'appworker hard nproc 256' > /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
id appworker
stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
cat /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf
